home.hint: Hold Ctrl + Alt and ask what's on your screen.
home.hint_bind: Bind a key to dalil --talk to ask from anywhere.

listening.note: No label. The live transcript is the only text.

waiting.label: Waiting for your click
waiting.idle: Still with me? Say skip to move on.

not_on_screen.message: I can't see {name} here. Open the screen that has it, then ask again.

ask.empty_hint: Ask about anything on your screen.
ask.empty_reply: I don't have an answer for that yet.

steps.heading: Add the place values

checklist.heading: Turn on Night light
checklist.subtitle: Dalil ticks each step once it sees you do it.

setup.intro: Dalil talks only to the endpoint you give it.
setup.first_run: Connect an AI endpoint to begin.
setup.empty: Enter a base URL to see its models.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.helper: Works with or without /v1 at the end.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.helper: Optional for local servers. Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

header_name.label: Header name
header_name.helper: Change this only if your server asks for another header.

scheme.label: Scheme
scheme.helper: Bearer puts the word Bearer before the key. None sends the key as it is.

model.label: Model
model.helper: Dalil uses this model for every answer.

model_id.label: Model ID
model_id.placeholder: The exact ID your server uses
model_id.helper: Copy it from your server's own documentation.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.helper: Only needed if your server expects a different header or scheme.

voice.label: Voice
voice.helper: Used when you talk to Dalil. Leave empty if your endpoint has no audio support, typing still works.

use_screenshots.label: Use screenshots
use_screenshots.helper: Send a screenshot only when a control isn't in the app's structure.

test.helper: Sends one short request to check the model answers.
test.fail: Test failed. Try another model, or check the URL and key.

disclosure.remote: Your question and the visible controls go to {host}. Screenshots only if you turn them on.
disclosure.remote_screenshots_on: Your question, the visible controls and screenshots go to {host}.

setup.cors_note: If a local server refuses Dalil, turn on CORS in its settings.

no_model_list.message: This server has no model list.

not_a_model_list.message: The server answered, but not with a model list.

route.name: Memory
route.line: What Dalil remembers about you. Search it, forget one topic, or forget everything.

page.title: Memory
page.intro: What Dalil remembers about you, kept on this computer. Search it, forget one topic or forget everything. Nothing here is sent anywhere unless you ask a question that uses it.
page.live_note: Sample topics, for layout only. Forget removes them from this page, and Esc closes the panel.
page.states_note: Every state the list can show, drawn by the same panel as above.

memory.title: What Dalil remembers
memory.lead: Topics from your lessons, newest first.
memory.empty: Nothing yet. Dalil remembers a topic once you get it right, need help with it, or ask about it.
memory.privacy: Stored on this computer. Nothing here is sent unless you ask a question that uses it.

forget_all.confirm: Forget all {total} topics? This can't be undone.

empty.title: Empty
empty.note: Nothing learned yet. The privacy line still says where it lives.

no_match.title: No match
no_match.note: The search finds nothing. Show all topics brings them back.

list.title: List
list.note: Newest first. Forget removes one topic, and forget everything asks once.

binary_decimal.note: Added the place values where the bit is 1, and got 45 right the first time.

division_remainder.note: Kept the quotient and dropped the remainder. Worked 45 out in groups of 2 to fix it.

display_settings.note: Found Night light under Display without help.

night_light.note: Turned it on, then missed the schedule options under the switch.

figma_layout.note: Set padding and gap on the frame instead of dragging its edges.

screenshot_shortcut.note: Asked how to capture one window. Nothing to practise yet.

dark_mode.note: Asked where the theme switch lives. Only asked, so there is nothing to practise yet.

route.name: Projects
route.line: Keep lessons and context apart for each folder or piece of work.

page.title: Projects
page.intro: A project keeps what Dalil learns apart, one per folder or piece of work. Lessons with no project show in every project. Stored on this computer.
page.live_note: Sample projects, for layout only. Choosing one changes this page only, and Esc closes the menu.
page.working_in: Working in {name}. Lessons from this project and the ones with no project are used.
page.none_note: No project. Every lesson Dalil has is used.

switcher.empty: No projects yet. Name one below.

errors.long: Keep the name to 60 characters or fewer.
errors.duplicate: A project with this name already exists.

endpoint.label: AI endpoint
endpoint.helper: {host}. Change the URL, key or model.
endpoint.helper_local: On this computer. Change the URL, key or model.

model.label: Model
model.helper: Used for every answer. Pick another from the list.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.helper: The small mark disappears until you hover the top edge.

use_screenshots.label: Use screenshots
use_screenshots.helper: Send a screenshot only when a control isn't in the app's structure.

large_pointer.label: Large pointer
large_pointer.helper: A bigger pointer and a thicker ring, easier to follow.

reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion
reduce_motion.helper: Follows your system setting. Flights become short fades.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.helper: Hold Ctrl + Alt to ask. Tap it to open Home.

name_in_greeting.label: Name in greeting
name_in_greeting.helper: Leave blank to use your first name from the system.

states.rest: Dalil is resting at the top of the screen.
states.home: Home open. Hold Ctrl + Alt to ask.
states.correcting: Off track. Press Esc to go back.
states.error: Something failed. Choose an action to continue.
states.ask: Ask open. Type a question and press Enter.

icon_buttons.endpoint_chip_local: Endpoint on this computer. Open setup.
